notes: Audit fix: the Network page's rate used to stick for a full extra second between updates and read blank for up to 2 seconds after the app opened, because network was sampled at half the rate of CPU/memory/GPU for no real benefit. It now samples every tick. Also fixed: opening the Health check page could freeze the whole app for a second or more, because its checks (including a powercfg process spawn) ran fully on the calling thread instead of in the background.
